test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following festivals is NOT celebrated in the river island of Majuli?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Parba.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Raj Parba is a carnival celebrated in Odisha in India.
 
• Also known as Mithuna Sankranti, Raj Parba, the Hindu carnival is generally celebrated for three to four days in the middle of June. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Ali-Aye-Ligang Festival in **Assam** is held every time on the first Wednesday of the month of **Gimur Polo** or **February (Gregorian timetable).** 
 
• Ali-Aye-Ligang is a traditional carnival of** Machines**, the **second largest lineage of Assam.** 
 
• **Falgutsav, Doul Yatra, or Phakuwa** is a festival of colour.
 
• **Bihu Festival:**
 
 
• Bihu is the **substance of Assam **and is celebrated across the state with tremendous zeal and enthusiasm. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
